name: Osteochondritis Dissecans of the Capitellum
definition: Focal osteochondral lesion of the capitellum seen especially in adolescent overhead or weight-bearing athletes.

investigations.principle: Radiographs may show lesion; MRI evaluates stability and cartilage.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Unstable lesions may require drilling, fixation or osteochondral procedures.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara Asthi-Sandhi phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Focal osteochondral lesion of the capitellum seen especially in adolescent overhead or weight-bearing athletes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
